title: mORMot2 Daily findings payload
description: Security and regression review of one edition. Separate from the summary on purpose: a summary that is slightly off is corrected the next morning, a wrong finding is not. Nothing here ships unless it carries evidence the validator can re-check against the source at that sha.

reviewed_shas.description: Every commit the reviewer actually looked at. Coverage is checked against the raw payload.

why_unproven.description: What was missing: a caller list, runtime behaviour, a platform build.

unverified.description: Where the reviewer smells something but cannot prove it. Never published as a finding; kept so a human can look.

check.description: What kind of defect this is. The list is a filing label, not a filter: the scope of the review is open, and what gates a finding is the evidence, the reachability and the refutation pass. 'other' is legitimate.

explanation.description: The mechanism, in order: what the code does, what input drives it wrong, what happens then. No speculation about severity.

quote.description: Verbatim source, copied character for character. The validator fetches the file at that sha and rejects the finding when the quote is not in it.

reachable_from.description: The public entry point an attacker or a caller can actually touch. 'internal only' is not a finding, it goes to unverified.

path_quote.description: Verbatim source showing the call that connects the entry point to the defect. Re-checked like the rest.

refuted_by.description: Filled by the second pass when it tried to refute the finding and failed. States what it checked.
